support_policy.source: PCM16 RIFF WAV mono/stereo, 8–192 kHz, nonempty, at most 600 seconds and 256 MiB; sample rate divisible by ten
support_policy.short_term: Complete 3-second windows at exact 100 ms hops; values below -70 LUFS explicitly unavailable by adapter policy, not an EBU gate
support_policy.integrated: At least 400 ms; silent/below-absolute-gate evidence unavailable; incomplete final gating block discarded
support_policy.loudness_range: At least 60 seconds and ten short-term observations >= max(-69.999, reported LRA threshold + 0.1); unavailable otherwise
support_policy.true_peak: At most 48 kHz, separate peak-only pass with 100 ms zero extension to flush FFmpeg resampler; zero extension never affects source or unpadded loudness. Above 48 kHz unavailable; tracked by #55.
support_policy.partial: Successful Pipeline v3 completion may produce normalized Partial analysis with explicit unavailable measurements
support_policy.precision: FFmpeg summary 0.1 dB/LU; short-term metadata 0.001 LUFS; precision is not an accuracy guarantee
support_policy.qualification: Local generated-fixture acceptance only; no EBU compliance, cross-platform equivalence or release qualification
